notes.title: All Levels in Bolt Bot are now playable!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/dfc7623728d2971b940f8944cdfafaa6942c0e70.png"][/img]

[b][u]48 Levels To Explore! [/u][/b]

Every single level in Bolt Bot can now be played! The whole game is now available to play from the start to finish right now! The game has a total of 48 levels which are set in many different themes such as Green Forests and the Wild West. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/7472e137b58642e73cb2d84595a98928e99c7c9f.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/970a2d38b405e7e1325c8abe84f720442015a118.png"][/img]

[b][u]Platforming Fun![/u][/b]

Each level has different combinations of tools and upgrades which Bolt can use. Bolt can glide around in some levels and in others, he can grind on rails. The game has a total of 14 Tools and Upgrades for Bolt to play around with! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/fc659d01697eaf336b404f3147458b18bfa2e244.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/910b8d39b0334da24b7b141744543f27ee59f987.png"][/img]

[b][u]Bonus Levels[/u][/b]

These are unlocked by collecting all the scrap in two levels which are next to each other. The bonus levels play differently to the main levels, so if you love collecting things in 3D platformers, you will be rewarded with more gameplay variety! For example, one level is a side scrolling platformer and another allows you to change the camera view to find secrets around corners.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/fcf91169693d6afa82e53565fd3649854ed8626f.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/e01a129ca36b26a0b9755b85e876a138e455d4d2.png"][/img]
[b][u]Game Length[/u][/b]

The game lasts for around 15 - 20 hours depending on how much you collect in the game! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/973a741595204dad62a9e34ecb799554e0190da5.png"][/img]

[b][u]Steam Achievements[/u][/b]

Bolt Bot has 26 Steam Achievements to add to your collection and they are all achievable right now! None of the achievements are missable, so you don't have to worry about starting a new game to collect any remaining achievements. Most of the achievements are for collecting each type of collectable in each world! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/59b24d254ad17866a80e32783111655cd7f871e2.png"][/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/1b4345a3118aaa1338194fe4d9a89983446b7919.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Frosty Fixings World Update OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=BJs6gHyydMw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]How To Start[/b]
If you have already beaten the Boss in World 3, the first time you load the game and enter the shop, a cutscene of 4-1 unlocking will appear. If you have yet to beat the World 3 Boss, world 4 will simply unlock naturally after you do so.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/92536482d1ea1cf6563636dcc51c90f3fc35c04a.png[/img]


[b]Early Acesss Current State[/b]
The game is now fully complete. It can now be beaten from start to finish. All steam achievements are now achieveable! 


[b]What has been added?[/b]
Below is everything that has been added in the Frosty Fixings update-

• 12 New levels to beat.

• 1,260 Pieces of Scrap to Accumulate

• 208 Viruses to destroy and Squish.

• 21 Microchips to find.

• 12 Collectable Cards.

• 1 Music tracks for Bit's and Bot's.

• 2 Spray Paints for Bolts appearance.

• 2 Staff Members to hire.

• 7 Golden Tills to smash.

• New Tools and Upgrades for Bolt such as Paint Brush which allows Bolt to bring blueprints to life and some Ice Skates which allow Bolt to skate on ice and grind on rails.

• New section of the Hub World has been added.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/e01a129ca36b26a0b9755b85e876a138e455d4d2.png[/img]


[b]Gameplay Reminders For Returning Players[/b]

• Press Key E or Xbox Y to interact with things such as Switches, Ladders, Chests, Bolts rocket etc

• Portal objects must be rolled into to be destroyed. Press Key CTRL or Xbox B to roll.

• To inspect what upgrades Bolt has on press Tab or the Xbox directional pad. (This will also show some controls in game)

• You can change the tools you have collected by pressing the keyboard number keys or the Xbox directional pad.

• Rolling in the air allows you to jump a tiny bit further. This will be useful in some of the levels in world 4!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/25138b09d4e242469a29071e18985d393b13feda.png[/img]


[b]Levels Ammount Changes.[/b]

Originally the game was meant to launch with just over 50 levels, but i think it's best to smooth out the levels which have already been made and fix any remaining minor bugs for the final release. The game will now fully launch with 48 levels. The games completion time is estimated at  15 - 20 hours.


[b]Thank You Everyone![/b]

Thanks to everyone who has been playing during early access. Bolt Bot has been in development for nearly 5 years now and it definitely would not be in the state its currently in without the feedback you have been sending through emails etc. If you do find any remaining bugs please get in contact at dreamsafeconnect@hotmail.com There is also a new thread in the Bolt Bot Steam forums for any bugs or issues found in World 4 Frosty Fixings. Thanks again!


Thanks 
All the best
Chris

notes.title: Bolt Bot Environment Update!

Bolt Bot V2.1 brings a major environment update to World 1 Connection Shores and World 2 Western Wires to match the same level of quality found in the areas of World 3 Spooky Sparks.

Every single level in the two worlds has been visually improved, new fog, new particle emitters, rocks, plants, trees, grass and new 3D scenic backgrounds fitting the theme of each level all make an appearance. Where ever you look in each of the 24 levels from the first couple of worlds in the game, there will be something new in sight. 

Here is the trailer 
[previewyoutube=ilyQ_BKiF74;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you again for your continued support and i hope you enjoy this update. Hopefully with this massive update, it will make a full playthrough of Bolt Bot more visually appealing and seamless throughout.

notes.title: Spooky Sparks Out Now!
notes.notes:
[u][b]Spooky Sparks is out now! [/b][/u]
The first major content update for Bolt Bot is out now! 

[previewyoutube=9ryfNucOymU;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]How To Start[/b][/u]
If you have already beaten the Boss in World 2, the first time you load the game and enter the shop, a cutscene of W3-1 unlocking will appear. If you have yet to beat the World 2 Boss, world 3 will simply unlock naturally after you do so. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/16a0c5109371bb43fe3b945625fe5201bcc81f65.png[/img]

[u][b]What has been added?[/b][/u]
Below is everything that has been added in the Spooky Sparks update-

• 12 New levels to beat.

• 1,190 Pieces of Scrap to Accumulate

• 196 Viruses to destroy and Squish.

• 21 Microchips to find.

• 12 Collectable Cards.

• 2 Music tracks for Bit's and Bot's.

• 2 Spray Paints for Bolts appearance.

• 2 Staff Members to hire.

• 7 Golden Tills to smash.

• New Tools and Upgrades for Bolt such as Flame Boots that launch Bolt into the air and a construction hat that powers up various contraptions.

• New section of the Hub World has been added.

[u][b]Gameplay Reminders For Returning Players[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/6655b96fa7902a32df8cdd205611214d68263708.png[/img]

• Press Key E or Xbox Y to interact with things such as Switches, Ladders, Chests, Bolts rocket etc

• Portal objects must be rolled into to be destroyed. Press Key CTRL or Xbox B to roll.

• To inspect what upgrades Bolt has on press Tab or the Xbox directional pad. (This will also show some controls in game)

• You can change the tools you have collected by pressing the keyboard number keys or the Xbox directional pad.

(When the game is fully released there will be button prompts to make it easier to get back into the game after a break. I'm currently still figuring out what other controller support to add to the game in future)


[u][b]Difficulty[/b][/u]
The difficulty has been increased in World 3. If you find any part too hard, please let me know through email or the steam community discussions. There is two levels in particular i would love to hear your thoughts on. These are W3-B2 and the W3 Boss. Personally, i find W3-B2 to be very easy and think the difficulty should be increased, but i want to hear your thoughts about it before i do so. 


[b]Thanks
All the best
Chris
[/b]

notes.title: W3 Spooky Sparks First Look!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/519c2e2f40e6ccdab3721197c8038895c5d87742.png[/img]
[b]Firstly, I want to say a massive thank you to everyone who has been playing Bolt Bot during the early access period. The reviews and steam community discussions have really given me a good idea of what people have enjoyed about the game so far and hopefully W3 will reflect that. I honestly think Spooky Sparks is the best world yet and i'm excited to see what everyone else thinks of it too.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/fe4c9d83d20a9f2295c4f860839127fa6caea6fb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/81c3159cffcd073b18e8867ce2d7314595f2b385.png[/img]
[b]World 3 Spooky Sparks is the biggest update yet and is planned for an October release. The aim is for a Halloween release, as it would fit nicely with the theme of the new world, but if more time is needed to smooth gameplay elements out, i think its best to do so. If no serious problems occur during the final testing stages then the update will definitely arrive in October. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/52112e8df81489b078cd80bd57d7e37841396d6a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/3751b1e624a1efc2135821713f4099d7ffd66483.png[/img]
[b]As you can see, some levels actually take place indoors this time giving W3 more variety in the actual places you explore. New camera angles are also introduced when Bolt enters bonus like areas of the main levels. For transparency, all the screenshots taken have got all the graphics settings on max with the outline width set to 3. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/9857390e6c735aad68b71db56f3e2749f4aa3032.png[/img]
[b]Naturally, the difficulty has been increased in Spooky Sparks, however most of the more difficult challenges are found when trying to reach the more rewarding collectables. The aim of Bolt Bot has always been to allow players of all skill levels to be able to at least beat the game, but then having the harder platforming challenges occur for completionists. [/b]
